Diogenes wrote:
>
> Sorry, I don't recall if I ever asked this before, but since I forgot,
> I need to ask it again.
>
> Can Magic of the Smith be legally used to bring an equipment card into
> play which is one of the locquipment cards(i.e. Palatial estate,
> Catacombs, etc..)?

Yes.
Those cards are equipment until they are in play, so can be pulled
by Magic of the Smith.
